subject: general
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Ramprasad __has not been__ __able to come__ to work __since a week__ __due to fever__.
solution:
The correct answer is 'since a week​.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part 'since a week​' is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• We use **since** with a point in time in the past.
 
 
• **Example**: *They’ve lived in Oxford **since** 2004.*
 
 
 
• *​*We use **for** with a period of time in the past, present or future.
 
 
• **Example**: *He lived in Oxford **for **3 years and then he moved.*
 
 
 
• *​*Therefore, the use of 'since a week' in the sentence should be replaced with 'for a week' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Thus, the correct option is 'since a week​.'
 
• ​​The correct sentence__: *Ramprasad has not been able to come to work **for a week** due to fever.*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• **For** can be used with all tenses.

 
 
• **Example**: *They study for two hours every day.

 They are studying for three hours today.

 He has lived in Bangkok for a long time.

 He has been living in Paris for three months.*
 
 
 
• **Since** is normally used with perfect tenses.
 
 
• **Example**: *He has been here since 9 am.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• भाग 'since a week​' गलत है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• हम अतीत में एक समय के बाद के लिए **Since** उपयोग करते हैं।
 
 
• Example: *They’ve lived in Oxford since 2004.*
 
 
 
• हम अतीत, वर्तमान या भविष्य में समय की अवधि के लिए **for** उपयोग करते हैं।
 
 
• Example: *He lived in Oxford for 3 years and then he moved.*
